glosses: Associating to each element of the codomain exactly one element of the domain; establishing a perfect (one-to-one) correspondence between the elements of the domain and the codomain; (formally) both injective and surjective.

Then, by a straightforward, computable, bijective numerical coding, this idealized FORTRAN determines an EN. (Note: In this FORTRAN example, we could have omitted restrictions on I/O and instead used a computable, bijective, numerical coding for inputs and outputs to get another EN determined by FORTRAN.)

The proof that isomorphism is an equivalence relation relies on three fundamental properties of bijective functions (functions that are one-to-one and onto): (1) every identity function is bijective, (2) the inverse of every bijective function is also bijective, (3) the composition of two bijective functions is bijective.

glosses: Having a component that is (specified to be) a bijective map; that specifies a bijective map.

glosses: Se dit d’une application qui est surjective et injective, c’est-à-dire qui associe à tout élément d’un ensemble un unique élément d’un autre ensemble et réciproquement.

examples.text: L’application qui à chaque nombre réel associe son double (f(x)=2x) est bijective de R dans lui-même.
